text_block_list.text:
One day during training time. While 
waiting for Rhein Kraft to arrive—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Hello~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. ...Good afternoon, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I apologize for dropping by so 
suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no, it was me! I was the one who 
said, "Let's go talk to Trainer right 
away!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I would like to run alongside Rhein 
Kraft-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
1,600m and... if possible, after a few 
days' rest, 2,000m as well.
choice_data_list:
...The distance for the Oka Sho and the 
Shuka Sho, right?

...The distance for the Oka Sho and the 
Shuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I would love to urge you to 
try the 2,400m of the Yushun Himba as 
well, butââ

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"We are still merely in our Junior year. 
Taking on the Classic distance now would 
be a bit too hasty, I believe."

A calm judgment, just as expected from her 
intellectual and composed demeanor. Air 
Messiah nodded quietly. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Naturally, I shall do 
everything in my power to ensure it is not 
a waste of your time.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"—I would love the chance to spar with the 
current favorite to win the Oka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As fellow competitors aiming for the 
pinnacle of the Tiara.

Their tone is calm to the very end. 
...However, deep within their eyes, a 
distinct flame could be seen.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer! What do you think!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I really, really want to run with 
Messiah-san, though...!"
choice_data_list:
...Yeah. It's a great opportunity, let's 
do it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Yay!! Trainer said it's okay too, 
Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I look forward to 
working with you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Alright! Then let's start with the 
1600m.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here we go! A race against 
Messiah at the Oka Sho distance! I'm gonna 
do my best...!!

Rhein Kraft seems exceptionally fired up. 
Almost like she's leaning a bit too far 
forward—
choice_data_list:
You're really looking forward to it, 
aren't you?

You're really looking forward to it, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes, definitely!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...When I ended up in the same class as 
Messiah-san and talked to her for the 
first time, I actually got a little 
teary-eyed."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"B-Because! You know about it too, right, 
Trainer?!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —About Messiah-san's mother!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Not only did she run in all the Triple 
Tiara races, her record is also—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
3rd in the Oka Sho, 2nd in the Yushun 
Himba (Japanese Oaks), and 3rd in the 
Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible record! A respected 
senior Tiara Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To think I'm in the same class as her 
daughter! And what's more—that we're in 
the same generation, competing like this.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Saying I'm not excited would be a total 
lie!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I am honored that you think so.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Messiah-san...! Are you all ready?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sorry to keep you waiting. —Shall we 
begin, then?

And so, Rhein Kraft and Air Messiah stood 
side by side on the track—

First, at the Oka Sho distance... Training 
together over 1600m on turf got underway.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What's all this? Looks like you're 
doing something interesting! Huh, Rhein 
Kraft and Air Messiah, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like they're doing a tandem run. 
First, the front-runner Line Kraft moves 
up front... Yeah, she's setting a great 
pace."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Air Messiah excels at coming from 
behind, after all. How will things unfold 
in the final stretch...?!"

text_block_list.name: Craft & Messiah
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah! Yaaaaaah!

Just as the reporters were saying—the 
final stretch. Rhein Kraft picks up the 
pace. Air Messiah makes her move as well.

Solid timing. Her sharpness isn't bad 
either. And yet, however—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah~. Air Messiah just barely missed 
reaching her, huh... Rhein Kraft held on 
brilliantly. Though she already ran quite 
well back in the Hanshin JF too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
As for Air Messiah... hmm. No, it's not 
bad! Not bad at all, really.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well... yeah. That 'almost had it' 
feeling, how do I put it—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Can't help but remember her mother's race 
record.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hafu~...! Good work out there, 
Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! ...Good work today, Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks for running with me today. 
Looking forward to the next 2000m too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer-san! See you tomorrow~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew, mmmnn~...!! I worked super hard 
today too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(...Tomorrow is a training run with 
Messiah-san, and this time it's 2000m! I 
have to do my best――)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? Huh... Wait, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Oh no! I left my bottle on the track...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa, there it is! What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Wait. Over there... is someone still—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, ngh...! Thank, ngh, you very 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Catch your breath for a bit. 
—Hey, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"How's the time? Did you notice any 
change?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ain't much of a difference. Not bad, but 
not particularly better either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, your strategy patterns are way too 
textbook. No wonder nothing dramatic 
happens. You're just running totally by 
the book.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so. Even if it's minuscule, has 
there been any change?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I won't say it's nothin'. But it's only 
something you can catch with a timer I 
tweaked to the extreme—we're talkin' mere 
milliseconds.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. As long as I am improving, 
that is."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If it's just milliseconds, I'll stack them 
a thousand times over. And by doing so, I 
will change things. Steadily, reliably... 
just like Mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"There are regrets that can only be 
cleared that way. Things that can never be 
overturned otherwise."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I take after my 
mother... I will do it in a way only I 
can.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I will seize victory. And I will prove it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just how precious what my mother passed 
down to me truly is.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry, Shakur-san. Um, it's 
getting late, too... Air Groove-senpai, 
you don't have to keep us company either.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: From here, I'll go alone—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. No need to hold back. If you're 
willing to continue, I'll accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So? I take it that click of your tongue 
meant you agree, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Shut up. If we're gonna do this, let's do 
it. Double time, go!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Yes.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...! Messiah-san—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Messiah-san is... running carrying her 
mother's feelings. I thought I understood, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I knew... maybe I didn't truly 
understand. Messiah-san's earnestness... 
the depth of her feelings—!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *Gasp* ...This, this feeling...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's just like after the Hanshin JF... 
When I saw Heart's incredible late 
charge...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm getting... so restless—!

"...And on the following day, Rhein Kraft 
and Air Messiah faced off in a 2000m 
tandem run—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Taaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Uuuuughhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!!
choice_data_list:
(I got passed right at the end... 
Craft...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. You too, 
Craft-san, and Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, your next goal is 
the Fillies' Revue, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Same for me. And for Heart-san, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! *gasp*... Messiah-san and Heart-san are 
in the Fillies' Revue too...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That means the serious showdown will 
take place there once again.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Now then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, ...y-yeah, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I... lost. ...No. I can't stay like this, 
not like this!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(It's just like back with Heart-san. My 
feelings aren't strong enough—surely, not 
yet...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haa, phew...! Trainer, um! About the next 
menu...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *cough* *cough*?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*Cough*... I-I'm, I'm okay. Sorry about 
that... *Ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... That startled me. I'm kinda... 
having trouble catching my breath...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Pheeew... Yeah, just a bit. ...2,000 
meters sure is a long way."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa, wait, that's not it! Um, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The Fillies' Revue—it looks like 
everyone's going to be running in it...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Please make the training even tougher! I'm 
in your care!

Rhein Kraft's impatience. A faint murmur 
began to ripple through the crowd.

While carrying forebodings of turmoil... 
the Junior year was drawing to an end.
